verdict.rationale: Polar's own docs reference a versioned API reference covering endpoints such as Checkout Session and Webhook Events. The docs site also serves versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs that an interactive reference could be built on. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the root-path OpenAPI probe 404s only show those particular paths are empty, not that the docs-hosted specs are missing. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples in the reference, hands-on or independent confirmation of the reference experience.
